name: Globular Jar with Geometric Décor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；10th century；Yaozhou ware: medium gray stoneware coated all over with white slip, the decoration carved through the slip to reveal the underlying darker body, the exterior of the jar further covered with celadon glaze, the interior left unglazed; Made at Yaozhou kilns, near Tongchuan, Shaanxi province
